pr_body:
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/66173

These builtins have been changed to use HasPrivilege instead of executing SQL
queries internally.

Release notes: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/75855)
You'll need to update the expectations file. Also, consider adding cases where you set up more than one of each of the things.
~Error described in https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/76296 needs to be resolved~

issue_context.title: sql: improve perf of has_database_privilege, has_schema_privilege and has_sequence_privilege
issue_context.body:
Alternatively, "remove usage of `evalPrivilegeCheck`".

In #65766, we removed a bunch of nested SQL calls from the builtins from has_table_privilege and has_column_privilege. We should do the same for has_database_privilege, has_schema_privilege and has_sequence_privilege.

We should expand `HasPrivilegeSpecifier` to cover the remaining cases.

We should then add to the benchmark in `pkg/bench/rttanalysis/orm_queries_bench_test.go` and run `make test PKG=./pkg/bench/rttanalysis TESTS=TestBenchmarkExpectation/ORMQueries TESTFLAGS='-rewrite --rewrite-iterations=10'` to regenerate the output.

Epic CRDB-8948

review_comments:
can you add more tests to see how it scales with number of databases/schemas/sequences?

basically, in the setup, it can create multiple entities, and the Stmt to test can be something like
```
SELECT has_database_privilege(name, 'CREATE') FROM crdb_internal.databases;
```

for schemas, something like
```
SELECT has_schema_privilege(nspame, 'CREATE') FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace
```
Talked about the tests not supporting has_database_privilege offline. Updated the others.
Spoke with @ajwerner on slack about this.  Removing the `*4` makes the tests run much faster with larger (>4) rewrite iterations.
